title: Human Robotics Teaming in Development, Test & Evaluation, Verification and Validation (DTEVV) of Autonomous Systems
description:
Restriction: Permission from the ENTE Graduate Director.
Additional information: Students must have prior coursework similar to the content offered in basic programming (Python preferred) courses. Must also be enrolled in or completed an engineering capstone course like ENME472. Exceptions may be made on a case-by-case basis by the ENTE Graduate Director.
